text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is popular.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x) ::: Karen will binge-watch x.
Download(x) ::: Karen will download x.
Share(x, y) ::: Karen will share x to y.
Premises:
NetflixShow("Stranger Things") ∧ Popular("Stranger Things") ::: "Stranger Things" is a popular Netflix show.
∀x (Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
BingeWatch(karen) ↔ Download(x) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download("Black Mirror") ∧ NetflixShow("Black Mirror") ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror" and "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
BingeWatch(karen) → Share(x, lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it to Lisa.
Conclusion:
¬Popular("Black Mirror") ::: "Black Mirror" is not popular.
